# PR Requirements Review Checklist: Profile and Trip Management

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate for ownership, lifecycle, concurrency, mobile honesty, and compatibility requirement quality
**Created**: 2026-11-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements quality was reviewed; it does not mean implementation is complete.

## Ownership and Scope Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are ownership requirements defined for profile, trip, day, activity, active selection, receipts, and lifecycle evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the non-disclosing behavior for cross-account identifiers unambiguous across reads and writes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002; API §Stable errors]
- [ ] CHK003 Are authenticated persistent data and seeded demo data explicitly separated in every affected user journey? [Coverage, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the deferred boundaries for expenses, POI/routing, planning, offline sync, collaboration, and AI consistent across spec and plan? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope; Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK005 Are identity export, account purge, and product-owned data responsibilities specified without creating circular ownership? [Completeness, Spec §FR-044; Plan §Capability ownership]

## Profile and Constraint Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are every supported soft preference and hard constraint named with bounded/normalization expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “weakening a hard constraint” defined sufficiently for objective acceptance decisions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK008 Are clear/reset semantics distinguished from absent values and failed saves? [Coverage, US1/AC3]
- [ ] CHK009 Are profile snapshot and override requirements consistent with historical accepted-plan preservation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, FR-014–FR-019]

## Trip, Day, and Activity Lifecycle

- [ ] CHK010 Are trip progress, lifecycle, review, and active-selection states independently defined without contradictory combinations? [Consistency, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [ ] CHK011 Are all allowed and forbidden archive, restore, delete, recover, and purge transitions specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034–FR-038]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the 30-day recovery window and its boundary behavior objectively defined? [Measurability, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK013 Are date extension and shortening requirements complete for empty and populated removed days? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020–FR-021]
- [ ] CHK014 Are activity timing, overlap-warning, custom-reference, and deterministic-order requirements mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023–FR-028]
- [ ] CHK015 Are active-trip empty state and “no silent replacement” requirements covered for archive, deletion, conflict, and restart? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029–FR-031]

## Concurrency and Retry Semantics

- [ ] CHK016 Are expected-version obligations identified for every mutable aggregate and stale-edit scenario? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, FR-018; API §Request guards]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the difference between version conflict, state conflict, active-selection conflict, and idempotency conflict explicit? [Clarity, API §Stable errors]
- [ ] CHK018 Are idempotency scope, key reuse, fingerprint mismatch, persistence, and expiry requirements documented? [Completeness, API §Request guards; Data Model §MutationReceipt]
- [ ] CHK019 Are atomicity requirements defined for date resize, reorder, active switch, lifecycle transitions, and purge? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028, FR-035, FR-038]
- [ ] CHK020 Are recovery expectations defined so failed/conflicting edits preserve user input without automatic merge or overwrite? [Recovery, Mobile §Conflict and failure behavior]

## Mobile and Accessibility Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Are primary screens and connected navigation obligations complete for onboarding through lifecycle recovery? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040; Mobile §Screens]
- [ ] CHK022 Are 390×844, 200% text scale, safe-area, keyboard, touch-target, and scrolling requirements measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010; Mobile §Mobile quality]
- [ ] CHK023 Are unresolved/custom activity map and routing limitations honestly specified? [Coverage, Mobile §Mobile quality]
- [ ] CHK024 Are loading, empty, validation, network, conflict, and recovery states defined for both profile and trip flows? [Coverage, Mobile §Root states]

## Acceptance and Compatibility

- [ ] CHK025 Can every success criterion be evaluated without relying on an unspecified test environment or subjective wording? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK026 Are retry, two-session, restart, ownership, lifecycle, AI-disabled, and 100-trip scenarios represented in acceptance criteria? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002–SC-011]
- [ ] CHK027 Are compatibility expectations for identity, map, search, OSRM/playback, planner demo, and expense demo explicit and non-contradictory? [Consistency, Spec §FR-046–FR-047]
- [ ] CHK028 Are backup/audit privacy exclusions specific enough to prevent preferences, allergies, titles, and notes from appearing in evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-043, FR-045]

## Notes

- Standard-depth checklist for PR reviewers, focused on ownership/concurrency/lifecycle and mobile honesty.
- Leave items unchecked until a reviewer evaluates the requirements.
- `/speckit.implement` must not modify these reviewer-owned markers.
